messages:
Anya P: Heads-up — docs PR #4321 needs a quick pass. We changed the streaming iterator API last week; a few examples across Python/TypeScript/Go are now failing. Can someone take the migration checklist and update snippets?
Sam W: I can own the Go examples. Plan: replace the callback/Chunks() pattern with the new StreamIter async-style loop. Will open a mini-PR if needed.
Mike L: I'll pick up Python streaming + retry examples. Need to demonstrate the new iterator plus a simple exponential-backoff retry helper. Will keep snippets minimal.
Jules R (docs-bot): CI: docs-build failed on linkcheck for PR #4321 — dead link to /docs/old-pagination.md detected.
Anya P: Thanks. Two asks: (1) update code samples to show old->new call shapes briefly, (2) fix the dead link and any anchor changes. Keep the migration note one short paragraph.
Sam W: Quick Go draft below, will paste into PR comments for feedback:
```go
// previous (pre-migration)
resp, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for chunk := range resp.Chunks() {
    fmt.Println(chunk.Text)
}

// recommended (post-migration)
it := client.StreamIter(ctx, req)
for it.Next() {
    fmt.Println(it.Value().Text)
}
```
Mike L: Python draft (using context manager iterator + retry wrapper):
```py
# new iterator + basic retry
from time import sleep

def with_retry(fn, retries=3):
    for i in range(retries):
        try:
            return fn()
        except TransientError:
            sleep(2 ** i)
    raise

with client.stream_iter(prompt) as it:
    for chunk in it:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Anya P: Nice. One doc note on retries: recommend short capped retries with exponential backoff (total ~10s), and explicitly advise not to retry on 4xx errors. Add that as a one-liner near the snippet.
Mike L: Added the retry counsel in the PR comment and fixed the pagination link to /docs/pagination-mapping.md (anchor changed). Also adjusted example imports for readability.
Sam W: Ran local build, CI passes for Go examples. Pushed updated snippet to PR #4321.
Jules R (docs-bot): Deploy preview published for PR #4321 — https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai (linkcheck passed on preview).
Anya P: Great. Can someone review wording around the 'KV caching and batching' example? That section now references streaming semantics. @Tariq M or @Nina K any bandwidth for a quick pass?
Tariq M: I can review this afternoon. I'll focus on the paragraph that mentions batching thresholds and how they interact with streaming iterators.
Nina K: Quick read now — looks good overall. One small nit: remove the sentence that calls out the 'old API' by name in the top paragraph (makes the migration blurb cleaner).
Anya P: I'll merge in ~2h if no objections. Thanks all — will follow up if we need separate PRs for TypeScript examples. :rocket:
